Agent Name: NYC_Local_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: NYC_Local_Expert included "Five Points Academy" and "New York Martial Arts Academy" as potential options without properly verifying their distance from the New York Stock Exchange. Both schools were clearly outside the five-minute walking distance constraint, as evidenced by the distances provided later (1.3 miles and 3.2 miles, respectively). This oversight introduced unnecessary options to the search and wasted effort in verifying their schedules, which were irrelevant to the task. The error occurred during the initial identification of schools (Step 3).
